source:
## Provisional LLM-assisted claim annotation — one saved explanation

The final cell selects the first available with-history joint response in sorted saved-file order, regardless of explanation quality (falling back to the first available explanation). It displays the exact original facts, prediction, explanation and global citations, then makes **one fresh annotation call** using the versioned [annotation guide](docs/EXPLANATION_ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md). Earlier v1 responses retain their original facts and numeric policy; their group labels map into the three current parent groups. The target purchase is excluded.

No separate annotator model is configured. The cell reuses the loaded pinned Qwen model, or its existing local cache, and records that predictor and annotator are the same model. Annotation uses greedy decoding with up to 8,192 input and 2,048 output tokens to fit the guide, provenance and claim table. It saves the prompt, raw response, guide snapshot and diagnostics in a separate annotation folder. Re-running this cell makes another annotation attempt, without rerunning prediction. Labels are provisional and require manual review; annotation alone does not establish actual model influence or faithfulness.
